command: set -euo pipefail; cd /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual; echo ===SUBJECT===; sha256sum buehne_daemon.py buehne.html filmlook.js; echo ===RELIEF_SOURCE===; sed -n '135,180p' buehne_daemon.py; echo ===SERVICE_ENV===; PID=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-buehne.service -p MainPID --value); printf 'PID=%s\n' "$PID"; tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/$PID/environ | grep -E '^BUEHNE_RELIEF=' || echo BUEHNE_RELIEF_ENV=UNSET_DEFAULTS_TO_1; echo ===CANDIDATE_DIRS===; for d in augen_blink_relief2 augen_blink_ai augen_blink; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then echo DIR=$d EXISTS=1 REAL=$(readlink -f "$d"); for n in blink_000.png blink_006.png blink_011.png; do [ -f "$d/$n" ] && sha256sum "$d/$n" || true; done; else echo DIR=$d EXISTS=0; fi; done; echo ===HTTP===; for n in blink_000.png blink_006.png blink_011.png; do printf '%s ' "$n"; curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:8788/augen_blink/$n" | sha256sum; done; echo ===RESOLUTION===; if [ "${BUEHNE_RELIEF:-1}" = 1 ] && [ -d augen_blink_relief2 ]; then echo EXPECTED_RUNTIME_DIR=augen_blink_relief2; elif [ "${BUEHNE_RELIEF:-1}" = 1 ] && [ -d augen_blink_ai ]; then echo EXPECTED_RUNTIME_DIR=augen_blink_ai; else echo EXPECTED_RUNTIME_DIR=augen_blink; fi
